_comment: Move 2 'Verified Beats Plausible' ground-truth corpus (ADR-010/012/017). 30 hand-authored claims, 5 sources x 6 categories: 2 supported, 1 unsupported, 1 unverifiable, 1 wrong_attribution, 1 incorrect_computation. Every quote and computation operand was checked character-for-character against sources/*.txt at authoring time -- ground truth here is true by construction, not by a second model's opinion. See README.md in this directory for the scoring protocol.

claims.text: Anchor CDN's certificate incident affected only the api.anchorcdn.net hostname; other Anchor CDN hostnames were unaffected.
claims.quote: traffic to other Anchor CDN hostnames was unaffected

claims.text: 15 minutes elapsed between Anchor CDN's on-call page and full edge rollout of the new certificate.

operands.quote: paged by an external uptime monitor at 06:19 UTC
completed rollout to all edge nodes by 06:34 UTC

claims.text: Anchor CDN lost customer credentials stored in the affected certificate.
The expired API token belonged to a contractor account rather than an internal service account.
Anchor CDN's incident was detected by an automated staleness monitor.
claims._note: true fact, actually belongs to meridian_cache_postmortem.txt
claims.quote: detected by an automated staleness monitor

claims.text: Anchor CDN's certificate failure lasted 44 minutes, from expiry to full edge rollout.

operands.quote: completed rollout to all edge nodes by 06:34 UTC

claims.text: No write requests were affected by Cobalt Storage's degraded-node incident, and no data was lost.
claims.quote: No write requests were affected, and no data was lost

claims.text: 10 minutes elapsed between Cobalt Storage detecting the degraded node and draining it from the read path.

operands.quote: identified through per-node latency percentile alerting at 03:31 UTC
drained from the read path at 03:41 UTC

claims.text: Cobalt Storage's eu-central-1 incident triggered a full regional failover to a backup datacenter.
The failing disk had been in service for over four years before it began degrading.
Cobalt Storage's incident was caused by a database connection pool exhausted by a misconfigured batch job.
claims._note: true fact, actually belongs to ridgeline_auth_postmortem.txt
claims.quote: a database connection pool was exhausted by a misconfigured batch job

claims.text: Cobalt Storage's degraded-node incident lasted 61 minutes end to end.

operands.quote: Starting at 02:50 UTC on 2026-07-29
drained from the read path at 03:41 UTC

claims.text: No customer data was exposed or corrupted during Meridian Cache's stale-content incident.
claims.quote: No customer data was exposed or corrupted

claims.text: 27 minutes elapsed from the start of Meridian Cache's incident to full cache freshness being restored.

operands.quote: Starting at 03:14 UTC on 2026-05-11
Full cache freshness was restored by 03:41 UTC

claims.text: Meridian Cache's stale-content incident caused several customer purchase transactions to be double-charged.
The message broker involved in the partition rebalance was running a version several minor releases behind current.
Meridian Cache's consumer lag grew to approximately 340,000 unacknowledged messages at peak.
claims._note: true fact, actually belongs to solace_queue_postmortem.txt
claims.quote: Consumer lag grew to approximately 340,000 unacknowledged messages at peak

claims.text: 15 minutes elapsed between Meridian Cache's incident being detected and the broker partition being rebalanced.

operands.quote: detected by an automated staleness monitor at 03:22 UTC
the broker partition was manually rebalanced at 03:27 UTC

claims.text: Users with still-valid access tokens were not logged out during Ridgeline Auth's incident.
claims.quote: users with still-valid access tokens were not logged out

claims.text: 3 minutes elapsed between Ridgeline Auth's pool-saturation alert and the offending batch job being killed.

operands.quote: identified via connection-pool saturation alerts at 20:11 UTC
killed at 20:14 UTC

claims.text: Ridgeline Auth's connection pool exhaustion exposed session tokens for affected users in server logs.
The misconfigured batch job had been deployed earlier that same day.
Ridgeline Auth's renewal failure was traced to an expired API token used by the certificate-renewal automation.
claims._note: true fact, actually belongs to anchor_cdn_postmortem.txt
claims.quote: traced to an expired API token used by the certificate-renewal automation

claims.text: Ridgeline Auth's session-refresh incident lasted 22 minutes from onset to the batch job being killed.

operands.quote: killed at 20:14 UTC

claims.text: No messages were dropped during Solace Queue's consumer-lag incident, and the retention window was never approached.
claims.quote: No messages were dropped; the queue's retention window of 72 hours was never approached

claims.text: 8 minutes elapsed between Solace Queue detecting the slow receiver and throttling the partner's webhook concurrency.

operands.quote: identified the slow receiver via consumer-lag alerting at 12:03 UTC
throttled the specific partner's webhook concurrency at 12:11 UTC

claims.text: Solace Queue's order-events backlog caused permanent loss of approximately 12,000 messages.
The partner integration responsible for the slow webhook receiver has since been suspended from the platform.
Solace Queue's degraded disk was replaced during a maintenance window the same day.

claims.quote: the physical disk was replaced during a maintenance window the same day

claims.text: Solace Queue's backlog took 57 minutes to drain from onset to full completion.

operands.quote: Beginning at 11:45 UTC on 2026-07-03
Full backlog drain completed at 12:52 UTC
